resolutions.researcher_notes: A youm7.com (2022) article confirms the El Minya-Asyut oil products pipeline project's existence and length figures, but attributes it only broadly to 'the petroleum sector'/'the state', without naming any specific operating or owning company. A general almerja.com statement that Petroleum Pipelines Company (PPC), an EGPC subsidiary, administers Egypt's petroleum pipeline network was considered, but it does not name this specific line among its examples, so per the no-orphan/specific-attribution standard it is not used to support Owner1=EGPC for this PID.
